name: Ho Chi Minh City to Phu Quoc
summary: Fly. The ferry from the mainland exists and takes most of a day. On a short southern leg, the one-hour flight is the trip.

modes.note: Frequent from Tan Son Nhat. Add the resort transfer on the island.
Only if you want the slow route via Rach Gia or Ha Tien. Not a connection to Can Tho the same morning.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City to Phu Quoc — flight or ferry
seoDescription: Why the short flight is the way to Phu Quoc, and when the ferry is a different kind of day.

faqs.q: Can you see the Mekong and Phu Quoc in one day?
faqs.a: No. They are different directions out of the city.
